title: Bari Weiss and Douglas Murray Hate Qatar - But They Are Now Funded by It
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In tonight's edition, coming to you a day early due
to the Thanksgiving holiday, we look at the awkward position The Free Press's
Bari Weiss and Douglas Murray have been placed in after David Ellison took
billions of dollars from their sworn enemy. Plus, Semafor's media editor
offers some transparency on the outlet's Jason Miller scandal, and Matt Taibbi
goes back on his word.

Since the October 7 Hamas attacks, The Free Press's founder **Bari Weiss** and
columnist **Douglas Murray** have obsessively railed against Qatar and its
investments in Western media, portraying the nation as an evil anti-Israel
force while urging institutions to divest from it.

But what happens when the owner of the company they work for, who brought
Weiss aboard largely due to [her pro-Israeli
viewpoint](https://zeteo.com/p/behind-the-scenes-bari-weiss-cbs-london-gaza),
suddenly takes away one of their favorite talking points because he needed
billions of Qatari dollars to make [his media mogul
dreams](https://zeteo.com/p/is-this-failed-actor-nepo-baby-
now?utm_source=publication-search) come true?

It would appear Weiss, Murray, and their cohorts at The Free Press are finding
out in real time.
